svg.title: Thirty Days to an Evidence-Ready Trading Operation
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-08-first-thirty-days-roadmap; chart type: timeline_roadmap; title: Thirty Days to an Evidence-Ready Trading Operation; subtitle: Build sourcing, testing, cash controls, and buyer evidence before expecting a closed deal.; chapter number: 12; epistemic tag: operating_framework; assumptions note: Numeric values indicate milestone order. The four periods cover Days 1–30 without gaps; the final period contains nine days. These are readiness milestones, not revenue commitments. Canonical time to first deal remains 3–9 months.; caption: End the sprint with a controlled acquisition pipeline and testable unit economics, not an invented first-month sale or compulsory purchase.; stages: label: Days 1-7; value: Define scope and establish the evidence register; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Select two supported device families and one destination market. Record applicable FDA activity questions, state requirements, intended use, title documents, and data exposure. Build a serial-level SQLite or spreadsheet register with links to a restricted-access evidence folder.; label: Days 8-14; value: Qualify supply and verify buyer demand; numeric value: 2.0; detail: Interview five prospective buyers and screen ten distinct seller lots. Record model preferences, budget authority, installation constraints, and comparable asking prices. Obtain written biomed and freight quotes for the two strongest lots without treating interest as a purchase commitment.; label: Days 15-21; value: Rehearse inspection and reconcile unit economics; numeric value: 3.0; detail: Inspect one authorized candidate with a qualified biomed contractor. Review storage-media access, decontamination evidence, test limits, service support, and title records. Reconcile quoted acquisition, repair, delivery, and warranty exposure against a defensible buyer price and the available cash buffer.; label: Days 22-30; value: Prepare one complete acquisition decision packet; numeric value: 4.0; detail: Assemble price ceiling, serial list, seller authority, classification review, service plan, sanitization method, delivery quote, and draft acceptance terms. Proceed only with resolved material issues and sufficient cash; otherwise retain a documented rejection and continue sourcing.

text.title: Thirty Days to an Evidence-Ready Trading Operation
text.tspan: Thirty Days to an Evidence-Ready Trading Operation

circle.title: label: Days 1-7; value: Define scope and establish the evidence register; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Select two supported device families and one destination market. Record applicable FDA activity questions, state requirements, intended use, title documents, and data exposure. Build a serial-level SQLite or spreadsheet register with links to a restricted-access evidence folder.

text.title: Define scope and establish the evidence register

circle.title: label: Days 8-14; value: Qualify supply and verify buyer demand; numeric value: 2.0; detail: Interview five prospective buyers and screen ten distinct seller lots. Record model preferences, budget authority, installation constraints, and comparable asking prices. Obtain written biomed and freight quotes for the two strongest lots without treating interest as a purchase commitment.

text.title: Qualify supply and verify buyer demand

circle.title: label: Days 15-21; value: Rehearse inspection and reconcile unit economics; numeric value: 3.0; detail: Inspect one authorized candidate with a qualified biomed contractor. Review storage-media access, decontamination evidence, test limits, service support, and title records. Reconcile quoted acquisition, repair, delivery, and warranty exposure against a defensible buyer price and the available cash buffer.

text.title: Rehearse inspection and reconcile unit economics

circle.title: label: Days 22-30; value: Prepare one complete acquisition decision packet; numeric value: 4.0; detail: Assemble price ceiling, serial list, seller authority, classification review, service plan, sanitization method, delivery quote, and draft acceptance terms. Proceed only with resolved material issues and sufficient cash; otherwise retain a documented rejection and continue sourcing.

text.title: Prepare one complete acquisition decision packet

Assumptions: Numeric values indicate milestone order. The four periods cover Days 1–30 without gaps; the final period contains nine days. These are readiness milestones, not revenue commitments. Canonical time to first deal remains 3–9 months.
